items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 2 October 2026 6:46am
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy today, starting with a few showers before more persistent and quite heavy rain develops around mid-afternoon. This will clear by late evening, with clear spells to follow overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10, risk of 15.


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, gradually increasing 20-25 by early afternoon, then becoming 25-30 with gusts of 35-40 for a time late afternoon and early evening. Veering W 15-20 through the evening, then further decreasing 10-15 late in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers. Occasional hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Strong winds.
